title: At least nine killed, several injured as vehicle carrying pilgrims rams into truck in Rajasthan’s Kota
points: At least nine people were killed in a vehicle accident in Kota, Rajasthan.
The vehicle was carrying 16 pilgrims returning to Maharashtra from Khatu Shyam.
Additional District Collector Rajesh Joshi confirmed the midnight crash with a truck.

title: Teenager killed in bus-bike collision as alleged over-speeding claims another life in Kochi
points: A teenager named Abhinav Sunil S. was killed in a bus-bike collision in Kochi.
The incident occurred around 9 p.m. on November 22.
The crash happened while the victim was riding from Kalamassery towards Edappally.

title: Police focus on 1,500 panchayats in Chittoor, Annamayya, Sri Sathya Sai districts ahead of polls
points: Police focused on 1,500 panchayats across Chittoor, Annamayya, and Sri Sathya Sai districts.
The heightened security and focus are ahead of upcoming local polls.
The State Election Commission scheduled three-phase polling for November 26, 29, and December 2.

title: Fake MCD parking slips used to dupe motorists in Old Delhi; two rackets busted in 24 hours
points: Fake MCD parking slips and forged receipts were used to dupe motorists in Old Delhi.
Two separate rackets were busted within 24 hours by the police.
Arrests were made near historical locations like Red Fort and Chandni Chowk.

title: Hemant Soren writes to CJI to urgently appoint Jharkhand HC Chief Justice successor
points: Jharkhand CM Hemant Soren wrote to the CJI regarding the High Court Chief Justice succession.
He highlighted the issue of repeatedly short leadership tenures in the Jharkhand HC.
The state frequently relies on interim Acting Chief Justice arrangements.

title: North Korea delays international marathon until October: tour agency
points: North Korea delayed its international marathon until October.
The race was previously held last year for the first time since the Covid-19 pandemic.
This year's initial race scheduled for April was cancelled without a specific reason.

title: Immigration officers make arrest at Seattle airport in ‘distressing’ scene, delaying flight
points: Immigration officers made a distressing arrest at Seattle airport, delaying a flight.
The Port of Seattle acknowledged distress caused to the affected family and passengers.
Local authorities plan to engage federal officials to understand the incident.

title: COP31: Turkiye's final draft doesn't mention the words ‘fossil fuels’ that cause global warming
points: Turkiye's final draft for COP31 omitted the mention of 'fossil fuels'.
COP31 President Murat Kurum gave negotiators about three hours to make objections.
The wording is set to go before the conference plenary.

title: U.S. blocks China’s remote access to AI chips after Nvidia scandal; China slams move
points: The U.S. blocked China's remote access to AI chips following a scandal involving Nvidia.
Nvidia's provision of chips to Southeast Asian data centers came under scrutiny.
China slammed the U.S. move restricting access.

title: China slams ‘malicious’ U.S. ban on telecom firms’ phone number access
points: China slammed a malicious U.S. ban on telecom firms' phone number access.
Affected entities include three major Chinese state-owned telecom firms.
The targeted companies are China Unicom, China Telecom, and China Mobile.

title: India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski
points: Envoy Mikki Kivikoski stated India and Finland seek to deepen economic ties.
The cooperation focuses heavily on the startup sector and ecosystems.
Finland aims to engage more with Indian startup actors.

title: What does EPFO’s Systematic Withdrawal Plan entail for retirees | Explained
points: EPFO proposed a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) for retirees.
Members can receive their accumulated PF corpus through periodic withdrawals.
This offers an alternative to taking a traditional lump-sum withdrawal upon superannuation.

title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
points: India's core sector growth reached a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026.
The massive jump was largely driven by an infrastructure push and low base effect.
Coal and electricity saw high growth, while fuel-related sectors contracted.

title: Coal auction rounds attract 85 bids; 20 first-time players enter sector
points: The 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions attracted 85 bids.
20 first-time players entered the coal sector during this auction round.
The auction put forth 25 blocks, including 21 fully explored and 4 partially explored mines.

title: CEA flags need to align capital markets with India’s development priorities
points: The CEA flagged the need to align capital markets with India's development priorities.
Equity market capitalisation stood at approximately 130% of India's GDP.
The corporate bond market accounted for only about 16% of GDP.

title: Health Wrap Episode 60 discusses healthcare spending, antimicrobial resistance and more
points: Health Wrap Episode 60 discussed key public health trends in India.
Topics included healthcare expenditure and regulation of fertility services.
The episode also highlighted antimicrobial resistance and environmental impacts on health.

title: One country, hundreds of dal recipes: exploring India’s diverse lentil traditions
points: An article explored India's diverse lentil traditions and hundreds of dal recipes.
It highlighted how the humble ingredient adapts across various soils and climates.
The tradition reflects diverse Indian histories, cultures, and kitchens.

title: Three cyclones in three weeks: What’s happening in the Bay of Bengal? | Explained
points: The Bay of Bengal experienced an unusual frequency of three cyclones in three weeks.
Historical post-monsoon data from 1982-2022 averaged around 1.8 cyclones a year.
The average frequency of post-monsoon cyclones has increased after 2001.

title: T.N. to set up Statewide online registry of voluntary donors with rare blood groups
points: Tamil Nadu decided to set up a Statewide online registry for voluntary donors.
The registry specifically focuses on donors with rare blood groups.
The initiative aims to streamline blood collection and emergency medical responses.

title: Andhra Pradesh gets national recognition for its progress in HIV/AIDS control
points: Andhra Pradesh gained national recognition for its progress in HIV/AIDS control.
Six districts achieved 'Surakshit' status and ten achieved 'Saksham' status.
Rankings are based on performance against UN 95-95-95 targets.

title: Max Verstappen wins the Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years
points: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years.
Verstappen started from pole position and held off Lando Norris on the final lap.
Oscar Piastri finished third and Antonelli fourth.

title: IND vs NZ 1st Test Day 4 Stumps: New Zealand trail by 233 after India’s mammoth 720/9 declaration
points: India declared its first Test innings against New Zealand at a mammoth 720/9.
This score is the highest total in a Test innings in New Zealand.
It surpassed New Zealand's previous record of 715/6 declared against Bangladesh in 2019.

title: Sandpapergate scandal: Lehmann denies knowledge of sandpaper plot, says scandal took him to ‘dark place’
points: Former Australian cricket coach Darren Lehmann denied knowledge of the Sandpapergate plot.
He stated the scandal took him to a dark place and led to his resignation.
The notorious ball-tampering incident happened 8.5 years ago.

title: Arsenal held to 2-2 draw by Newcastle
points: Arsenal was held to a 2-2 draw by Newcastle in a competitive match.
The draw moved champions Arsenal to 28 points in the league standings.
Arsenal sits six points clear of second-placed Brighton & Hove Albion.

title: Perception should score in the Chief Minister’s Trophy
points: Perception should score in the Chief Minister's Trophy.
This relates to a sports and cultural event initiative.
It emphasizes presentation and public perception in competitive events.

title: India Emerges as Third-Largest Arms Exporter to Europe: Defence Secretary - News On AIR
points: India emerged as the third-largest arms exporter to Europe.
The announcement was made officially by the Defence Secretary.
This highlights India's growing domestic defense manufacturing capabilities.

title: India's Defence Strength Powering National Security through Self-Reliance - www.pib.gov.in
points: India's defense strength is actively powering national security through self-reliance.
The focus remains on Atmanirbhar Bharat in military production.
PIB highlights continuous advancements in indigenous defense technology.

title: Indian Navy receives indigenously built diving support craft DSC A21 in Mumbai - DD News
points: The Indian Navy received an indigenously built diving support craft named DSC A21.
The handover ceremony took place in Mumbai.
It marks another milestone in indigenous naval manufacturing.

title: Karkala’s Sachidananda Prabhu Promoted to Major General in Indian Army - Mangalore Today
points: Sachidananda Prabhu from Karkala was promoted to Major General in the Indian Army.
This is a prestigious promotion for an officer hailing from Karnataka.
His achievement was highlighted by regional media.

title: President Droupadi Murmu to review passing-out parade of Navy trainees in Kannur on Nov 28 - The New Indian Express
points: President Droupadi Murmu is scheduled to review the passing-out parade of Navy trainees.
The event will take place in Kannur.
The ceremony is scheduled for November 28.
